description: Election Commission - Notify the name of D. N. Sanjeewa as a Member of the Kegalle Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kegalle Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's death, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members for local authorities, which falls under the Elections classification category.
